verdict.rationale: Raygun documents marking fixed errors as 'Resolved' and claims deployment tracking that identifies 'new errors or regressions', and it offers custom alerts via email, Slack or Teams. Nothing shows a resolved error automatically reactivating in a newer release, or triggering an alert specific to regressions and separate from new-issue alerts. missing for 10: documented auto-reopen of resolved errors on recurrence in a later version, a regression-specific alert type distinct from new-error notifications, version-aware regression detection details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I get alerted when an error that was fixed comes back in a newer release, distinct from ordinary new-issue noise

citations.quote: Track every deployment in real time to identify any new errors or regressions.
Once you've fixed a particular error, you can mark an it as 'Resolved'.
Alerts via email, Slack or Teams. Get custom alerts to where your team already works
